notes.title: Exploring the Universe of "At the Dream End". - Release date: 28/04/2023
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43349548/bd492f4b11ebfc7e7e185684a8dd2231f43d359e.png[/img]

As our first Steam game's release date draws nearer (28/04/2023), we will be sharing more details about the expansive universe in which the game is set, as well as our ambitious plans for future installments in the series.

Our vision for this series is to create a vast dark sci-fi universe where each story stands on its own, but all of them are interconnected. Each game will feature unique characters, settings, and storylines, but they will all be set in the same universe, allowing players to discover more about the lore and history of this world as they play.

One of the central themes of our universe is the concept of energy. In this universe, humans understand that the energy that gives them life is a fundamental force of the universe. They've developed technologies to harness this energy, but they're constantly discovering new ways to use it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43349548/ab28675d0721f0f1deaf304657bb3aeca79cf4d6.png[/img]

In the first game of our series, "At the Dream End," we introduced the concept of angels – beings that exist outside of our physical world. These angels are a mysterious force that humans are only beginning to understand, and they play a pivotal role in the game's story.

But the angels are just the beginning. As we develop more games in this series, we plan to introduce new and exciting concepts that explore the depths of our universe. At the heart of our universe is the idea that the more we discover about the energy that drives us, the more we realize how little we truly understand. We hope that players will be captivated by the mysteries of this universe and feel compelled to keep exploring, year after year.

We're excited to continue developing the "At the Dream End" universe and can't wait to share more about it in the coming months. Stay tuned for more updates on our progress and the stories we have in store!

"At the Dream End" release date: 28/04/2023

notes.title: At the Dream End - Release Date Trailer
notes.notes:
We've been working hard on "At the Dream End" for a long time now, and we're thrilled to finally be able to share a final trailer that will reveal a release date for the game on Steam, GameJolt, and Itch.io. 

[previewyoutube=E3eZIfIEQcI;full][/previewyoutube]

We've put a lot of effort into crafting a compelling story that will keep players engaged and invested in the game's characters and plot.

But the story of "At the Dream End" isn't the only thing that will keep players coming back for more. We've also designed the game to be full of lore for players to discover. As players explore the game's world, they'll uncover clues and secrets that will shed light on the game's history and lore. For those who love to immerse themselves in a game's world, "At the Dream End" will be a treasure trove of information to uncover.

Of course, we know that some players love a good challenge, and that's why we've included rewards for those who are dedicated enough to discover all of the game's secrets. Whether it's a hidden item or a difficult puzzle, players who are willing to explore every nook and cranny of the game will be rewarded with valuable items and insights into the game's story and lore.

We can't wait to see how players react to the game and discover all the secrets that we've hidden throughout the world.

Besides this news here you can find a video and see how the MMM Games team finds inspiration for games and stories :) 

[previewyoutube=LFwk1vuZ1PM;full][/previewyoutube]

In the meantime, we encourage players to check out the demo and let us know what they think. We're always open to feedback and suggestions, and we're committed to making "At the Dream End" the best game it can be.
